featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience at this petrol pump. I regularly fill petrol in my TVS Jupiter ZX when the fuel indicator is at 1–2 bars. But every time I fill petrol here, the amount required is much higher compared to other pumps. For example, at the same fuel level, when I fill petrol at other pumps, it usually costs around ₹100 less.
I also observed that if someone remains seated on their scooty while filling fuel, especially when the fuel tank is at the back side (like in my Jupiter), the staff will definitely cheat you. This is not only my personal experience but also something I have observed happening with others while waiting in the queue.
Even if you carefully look at the meter while filling, they still manage to cheat somehow. I don’t know what kind of setting or manipulation is done, but the fuel quantity is always less compared to other pumps.
This repeated experience makes me feel that something is not right here and gives a strong impression of scam-like or unfair practices. As a customer, I feel cheated and very disappointed.
I would strongly advise the management to look into this matter seriously and maintain transparency, and I would suggest other customers to be cautious while filling petrol at this pump.

I am a regular customer at your petrol pump and have always preferred your outlet for fueling my vehicle. However, my recent experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.
Yesterday, when I came to refill my vehicle, the person handling the fuel pump was neither wearing a proper uniform nor displaying an identity card. This itself raises serious concerns about staff authenticity and management supervision.
While fueling, the amount stopped at ₹399.44. I politely requested him to make it ₹400. He said it would go to ₹402, and I clearly agreed to pay that amount. Instead of responding professionally, he rudely replied, “Who will give the change? Will you give me?” He repeatedly asked whether I had come for the first time to fuel my vehicle and kept murmuring in a disrespectful tone. His behavior was arrogant, insulting, and completely unacceptable.
This kind of attitude is not expected from staff representing a petroleum outlet. Customer service requires basic courtesy and professionalism, which were clearly missing.
If staff cannot behave properly with customers, it reflects serious mismanagement. I strongly urge you to:
Ensure all staff wear proper uniforms and identity cards.
Provide proper customer service training.
Take strict action against such misconduct.
Incidents like this damage your outlet’s reputation. If corrective action is not taken, I will be compelled to avoid your petrol pump in the future and advise others to do the same.
I expect a prompt response and necessary action.
Sincerely,
Nikesh Chavan

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a disappointing experience at this petrol pump today. I asked the attendant to fill petrol worth ₹3000, but he initially filled only ₹300 and claimed he misheard me. He then said he would continue for the remaining ₹2700.

However, I was carefully watching the meter and noticed that it resumed from ₹300 instead of resetting to zero. When he stopped at ₹2700, he claimed the total amount was completed, which was clearly incorrect. After I confronted him and pointed out what I observed, he hesitated but eventually corrected it and filled the full ₹3000.

This raises serious concerns about transparency and honesty. I strongly advise others to stay alert and always ensure that the meter is reset to zero before fueling. Keep a close eye during the entire process—otherwise, there is a real risk of being misled or overcharged.
